name: spend-a-friend
description: Spend-A-Friend - Multi-currency expense splitting web app (Frontend: Vercel, Backend: Render)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,cyan" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.ship: git add . && git commit -m "update" && git push origin main
